summary.text: John Hoeven was sworn in as North Dakota's U.S. Senator on January 5, 2011, after ten years as the state's governor.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Bismarck, earned a bachelor's degree from Dartmouth College in 1979 and an MBA from Northwestern University in 1981.
Before public office he was an executive vice president of First Western Bank in Minot from 1986 to 1993 and president and CEO of the Bank of North Dakota from 1993 to 2000.
He lives in Bismarck with his wife Mical.
